mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates increase the cost of capital and reduce corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as increased production boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals a disinflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower inflation reduces input costs and increases real earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL declines and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and the number of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate falls below 2%, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and investment decline.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and GDPC1 growth < 2%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of HOUST and GDPC1 on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as low rates encourage borrowing and investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between low FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
